description: Communes éligibles au très haut débit is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Laurine Dantan. Digital spatial planning: list of 93 municipalities eligible for the call for projects to cover very high-speed broadband in Saône-et-Loire. Coverage: Laurine Dantan. The portal shows the English title as "Communes eligible for very high-speed broadband" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Laurine Dantan. Its keywords include thd, debit, internet, durable, numerique, amenagement. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV, API. The listing shows 2015-12-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
